admission.justification: Dashboard owner units executed through the shared accounting helpers. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Dashboard owner units executed through the shared accounting helpers.
conditions: Thread CPU is sampled around synchronous work on its executing thread.
Offloaded cancellation drains the actual worker before propagation.
exclusions: Await time and unrelated event-loop work are not worker CPU.
statement: An offloaded owner records its executing worker thread once, while synchronous publication uses its own event-loop interval and cancellation drains the exact worker.
